en.sarwar: 3. Humayd ibn Ziyad has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Sama‘ah from Ahmad ibn al-Hassan al-Mithamiy from Aban ibn ‘Uthman from ‘Ubayd ibn Zurarah and abu al-‘Abbas who has said the following: “
Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘A man must not go to bed with a woman in a Wednesday night.’”
